source_identity_rule: For each copied source file, record source-relative path, destination-relative path, and source/destination SHA-256; source and destination hashes must match at initial copy.
excluded: tokens, credentials, private keys, authorization bindings

historical_resource_boundary.interpretation: Lower bound only; do not reset or represent historical project CPU use as zero.
historical_resource_boundary.v3_accounting: separate measured ledger; historical unknown remains separately disclosed
